entries.text: SESSION 2026-08-02: FIVE COMMITS 4cf8ef2..e95f3cb, all pushed, VPS deployed clean. ROOT CAUSE OF 'NOTHING STARTS WHEN I OPEN THE LAPTOP' - two independent causes, both verified: (1) every autostart route fires on LOGON only (Startup folder shortcuts + SmartEntryPro task); opening a lid is resume+unlock, which fires no logon trigger and does not re-read the Startup folder - uptime was 18 days since 15 July so nothing had auto-started at all and the stack was only ever hand-launched; (2) SmartEntryPro carries DisallowStartIfOnBatteries AND StopIfGoingOnBatteries and the laptop was on battery, so Task Scheduler REFUSED it - LastTaskResult 2147946720 (0x800710E0) was sitting on five of eight SmartEntry tasks. SHIPPED: (a) 4cf8ef2 /api/trade-closed SQLite writes - THREE defects, two provable from the only real trade: db.updateLearning was passed 'win'/'loss' but db.js compares 'WIN'/'LOSS' so a real -449.72 loss incremented NEITHER counter (learning row read wins=0 losses=0 total_pnl=-449.72); both db calls sat outside the pnl!==null guard so an unknown-P&L close wrote a fabricated $0 LOSS; insertTrade reads stop/target/size/outcome/closed_at while the journal carries sl/tp/volume/status/closeTime, so 5 columns were NULL on every row. 16/16 tests. (b) 8421954 account attribution - the bridge has always sent 'account' (mt5_bridge.py:863,1439,1537) and the server dropped it on both ends; worse, ticket ids are unique per ACCOUNT not across the fleet (mt5_bridge.py:1384) while /api/trade-closed matched on ticket alone, so a collision closed the wrong trade and fed the wrong P&L to learning. Now matches ticket+account with a legacy-only ticket-only fallback; db.js gained the ALTER TABLE migration its init() docstring already promised. 14/14 tests. (c) 9632c08 closed the last FIVE untagged-bridge launchers (launch_auto, run_all, start_mt5, tasks/start_bridge, plus BRIDGE_MODE on the tagged pair); launch_auto.bat also still had `taskkill /F /IM node.exe /T` + python + terminal64, which kills every node/python/MT5 on the machine. (d) e95f3cb ensure_running.ps1 + install_autostart.ps1 - AtLogOn + SessionUnlock(StateChange 8) + 10-min repetition, battery cleared. TWO BUGS CAUGHT IN MY OWN CODE BEFORE SHIPPING: ensure_running v1 identified bridges by wrapper CommandLine and started a SECOND pair while both were alive - Win32_Process returns an EMPTY CommandLine AND ExecutablePath for these python processes (PIDs 19424/16584, cmdlen 0); presence now comes from /api/mt5/health?account=X plus a cooldown marker, and the whole step is skipped when the server is unreachable. And the Edit tool wrote start_bridge_A/B.bat with LF endings, which cmd.exe cannot parse - the wrappers spawned conhost and no python, so bridge recovery was silently broken; restored via git checkout (core.autocrlf=true). LOCAL STATE NOW: server, Bridge A #25446287, Bridge B #11581419, one guardian, one watchdog, both MT5 terminals, tunnel on 3002. Stray untagged bridge stopped (0 open positions). VPS: fast-forwarded to e95f3cb, all 4 protected files SHA-256 UNCHANGED, migration applied, Bridge A reconnected, BridgeB correctly Disabled, autostart sound because AutoAdminLogon=1. STILL OPEN, NEEDS YOUR Y: the three signal-gen changes - Gold squeeze unmute (written, uncommitted, and LIVE in the running server), gate 65->70 (only gate positive in 5/5 folds with TEST above TRAIN), structural-stop floor (index.js:1006-1012, one SPX trade came out at rr 55.24 and was +55.2R of a +39.5R cohort). ALSO OPEN: SmartEntryPro's battery block needs an elevated shell to clear; row id=1 in SQLite is still unbackfilled (protected data); /api/performance 404 was a FALSE ALARM in my own earlier note - nothing calls it and performance.html serves 200.

SESSION 2026-08-02 PART 2 - SIGNAL-GEN SHIPPED, user approved all three. a0862d1 + 1c4d98b, both machines live at gate 70. THE MEASUREMENT WAS CONTESTED AND I RE-RAN IT: tasks/logs/mtf_walkforward.txt held a run dated 2026-08-01 05:27 saying gate 70 = 2/5 UNSTABLE and gate 75 = 4/5, which flatly contradicted the note claiming 70 was 5/5. That artifact predates b55b5f5 and came from the harness that dropped 18% of Gold's history, so it is superseded, not contradictory. Fresh run on the repaired harness, engineThrows 0 on all three assets: gate 65 = 3/5, gate 70 = +0.151/+0.060/+0.359/+0.058/+0.142 = 5/5 ROBUST, gate 75 = 4/5 (fold4 -0.159), gate 85 = 0/4 CONSISTENTLY NEGATIVE. 'Edge lives above 75' is now measured dead. SHIPPED: (1) confidenceThreshold default 65->70 in code AND in strategy_settings.json on both machines; (2) Gold H4 MODERATE gets GOLD_SQUEEZE_MODERATE_CONFIDENCE=70 when daily is BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH, 55 otherwise; (3) STRUCTURAL_STOP_MIN_ATR=0.5 floor on structural stops. TWO INTERACTIONS CAUGHT BEFORE SHIPPING: the gate and the Gold cohort COLLIDE - the cohort was written at 65 to clear the old gate, so moving the gate to 70 in the same change would have made it dead code that never fires; and the cohort constant must NOT follow strategySettings.confidenceThreshold because the harness lowers that to 40 to expose sub-gate cohorts, so a follower gets replayed at 40 and drops out of the very gate-70 population it needs to be inside. Pinned at 70, Gold's 65-74 bucket went 187->439 steps, avgConf 51.9->64.1, and EVERY fold at gate 70 improved. Both new constants added to _replay_mtf.cjs SCALAR_CONSTS - its degradation detector caught the omission correctly on the first run (6225/9101/6211 throws, 'no trades produced by any asset'). I ALSO CAUSED AND FIXED A LIVE SIZING REGRESSION ON THE VPS: updating its gate through PowerShell Set-Content -Encoding utf8 wrote a UTF-8 BOM, JSON.parse threw on the first character, loadStrategySettings kept DEFAULTS and logged one line - fixedLotSize 0.01 became 0, which means full 1% risk-based sizing on a live --auto account configured for micro lots. The gate coincidentally matched its new default so only fixedLotSize gave it away. Fixed in 1c4d98b: BOM stripped before parse, failure message now states the consequence, and strategySettingsError is exposed on GET /api/strategy-settings. VPS file rewritten BOM-free, verified threshold=70 fixedLot=0.01 settingsError=none. LESSON: never write JSON with Set-Content -Encoding utf8 on PS 5.1; use [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText with UTF8Encoding($false). STATE AT SESSION END - LOCAL: gate 70, bridges A+B connected, 1 guardian, autostart task result 0 next 16:31. VPS: HEAD 1c4d98b, gate 70, fixedLot 0.01, Bridge A connected, BridgeB Disabled. DANGER NOW LIVE AND NEEDS A DECISION: raising Gold's squeeze cohort to the gate makes Gold materially more likely to fire, and local Bridge B and VPS Bridge A BOTH trade account 11581419 in --auto with separate 3-loss breakers. One Gold signal opens TWO positions on that account and the breaker needs six losses. This was already known and unresolved; my change increases the odds it materialises. SELF-LEARNING: deliberately NOT tuned. learning.json has exactly one real trade and getLearningBoost needs 5 per setup before it does anything - the correct outcome recording only landed today, so any tuning now is tuning against noise.
